rationale: After reading the historical evolution of anaesthesiology, students should identify the landmark event (Morton's ether demonstration) that marks the beginning of modern anaesthesia.
After reading the ethics section on consent in anaesthesiology, students must understand that consent for anaesthesia is legally and ethically separate from consent for surgery.
After the career prospects section, students should identify the diverse subspecialties of anaesthesiology to understand the specialty's breadth as required by AS1.2.
